# A lower headline rate is not always the better quote.

> Free calculator for estate sale commission quotes. Enter a company's tiered commission rates, setup fee, card-processing fee, and haul-away fee against your estimated sale total to see the real net proceeds — and compare two companies' quotes side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
